capabilities: repair malformed Markdown as it is pasted
format selected text or the whole document with commands
style tables, code blocks and headings in Reading View
toggle an optional Studio writing and reading style
extras: Not yet in the community plugin browser; must be installed manually from release files, and the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Detailed docs (guide, FAQ, troubleshooting) live outside the README.
motivation: The README's 'The problem it solves' section describes fixing pastes from chat assistants; no explicit personal motivation is stated.
problem: Markdown copied from chat assistants and websites often pastes into Obsidian as broken tables, bullets and links that need manual fixing.
summary: Markdown repair and formatting plugin that fixes broken Markdown on paste, tidies documents on demand, and refines Reading View styling.
